title: Stand Firm in One Spirit
summary: The enemy rages to move us off our foundation in Christ and sow confusion. Stand firm, and stand together with other believers in love and truth.
exhortation: It's almost four years to the day since I moved from California to Arizona. That came at the end of a stretch we all remember well. From 2019 until I left in 2023 were some of the most chaotic, confusing and unmooring times I've lived through. It isn't an exaggeration to call it madness. Many people were saying, "This is the gospel," "No, that's the gospel," and even people I respected seemed to come completely unmoored, leaving believers, or at least me, very confused.

Now, as a father of four who has gone through that, I feel the desperation and intensity in Paul's words: "Only let your manner of life be worthy of the gospel of Christ... standing firm in one spirit." It leaps off the page at me, because I see how the enemy rages to move us off our foundation in Christ and sow confusion everywhere he can, with every headline and every new philosophy that says, "This is what you must obey."
Paul is desperately praying for his church: stand firm. Don't come unmoored. Don't listen to any other doctrine, even if an angel brought it. Don't waver in your trust in the Lord Jesus Christ.

So my simple question this morning is: are you standing firm? And second, are you living in one spirit? Are we living with other Christians in a way that builds them up, coming alongside the weaker brother and saying, in love and in truth, "Brother, this is the gospel"?
prayer: Lord, let it be true of us that our manner of life is worthy of the gospel of Christ, and that in every waking moment we take our thoughts, words and actions captive for your kingdom. Give us Paul's compassionate heart for his people: one that doesn't cut down other believers but builds them up and helps them in faltering faith with love and truth, so that we stand in one spirit and one mind with our family of believers for the faith of the gospel.

Change us into your likeness, so that we are holy as you are holy and live lives worthy of the gospel, and the name of Jesus is lifted high in our lives and in all the earth. Fill us with a passion for your glory: to fight sin, to speak boldly and to work hard in the work of your kingdom. Fill us with the power of your Holy Spirit for the battles ahead, so that we are victorious in you, Jesus. We pray in Jesus' name. Amen.
